displayName: OCI-DB-FIRE-001: Firestore — Overly Permissive Security Rules
description:
Detects Firestore security rules allowing unauthenticated read/write access

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_db_fire_001", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%firestore%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%overly%') AND "value" > 0
